title: ForkServiceCreate

name.description: A human-readable name for the forked service. If not provided, will use parent service name with "-fork" suffix.

cpu_millis.description: The initial CPU allocation in milli-cores, or 'shared' for a shared-resource service. If not provided, will inherit from parent service.

memory_gbs.description: The initial memory allocation in gigabytes, or 'shared' for a shared-resource service. If not provided, will inherit from parent service.

fork_strategy.description: Strategy for creating the fork. This field is required.

target_time.description: Target time for point-in-time recovery. Required when fork_strategy is PITR.

environment_tag.description: The environment tag for the forked service, 'DEV' by default.

description:
Create a fork of an existing service. Service type, region code, and storage are always inherited from the parent service.
HA replica count is always set to 0 for forked services.
